directive:
Preserve the finite-sample nuisance-deletion, exact-hit calibration, and mechanism-deficiency spine, but make the following repairs.

1. Replace the simultaneous randomization assumptions by two mutually exclusive regimes. In the Bernoulli regime B(p), let L_1,...,L_C be iid Categorical(p), independent of the iid schedules, and conditional on L_c=ell let the coordinates of Z_c be independent Bernoulli(pi_ell). In the exact-count complete-randomization regime CR(alpha), choose integers C_{C,k} summing to C with C_{C,k}/C -> alpha_k, draw the label vector uniformly over allocations having exactly those label counts and independently of the schedules, and conditional on L_c=k draw Z_c uniformly on S_k. State separate theorem parts and dependency lists for B(p) and CR(alpha); never invoke unit-level Bernoulli assignment and exact-count assignment as simultaneous assumptions.

2. Make every Gaussian object face-projected and well-defined at design boundaries. For a tied-best face A, define G_A only for v_A in (0,infinity)^A and r_A in (0,infinity)^A, and extend it by +infinity whenever an active coordinate has r_k=0. Write R_{B,A}^*(v)=inf_{p in Delta_K} G_A(v_A,(Bp)_A), R_{CR,A}^*(v)=inf_{alpha in Delta_K: alpha_k>0 for k in A}G_A(v_A,alpha_A)=inf_{a in Delta_A^o}G_A(v_A,a). Inactive coordinates may be zero and must never be passed to G_A. Repair the mechanism theorem facewise: set s_A(p)=sum_{k in A}(Bp)_k, a_A(p)=(Bp)_A/s_A(p), and s_{A,max}=max_ell sum_{k in A}B_{k ell}. Then G_A(v_A,(Bp)_A)=s_A(p)^(-1/2)G_A(v_A,a_A(p)) and R_{B,A}^*/R_{CR,A}^* >= s_{A,max}^(-1/2)>1. Equality holds exactly when there exists a Bernoulli optimizer p supported on columns attaining s_{A,max} whose normalized active vector a_A(p) is CR-optimal. The old normalization over all K target counts is valid only when A=K; do not use it for a proper tie face.

3. Replace the DQM shorthand by an explicit target tangent and least-favourable submodel. Assume the policies in A tie at P_0 and are separated from A^c, and use H_A={h in R^A: sum_{k in A}h_k=0}. An explicit construction is to replace the unidentified joint coupling of the schedule coordinates by the observationally equivalent product coupling of its assignment-specific P_0 marginals, keep nontarget marginals fixed, and for z in S_k, k in A, exponentially tilt the observed outcome-vector marginal by dP_{t,h,z}/dP_{0,z}(y)=exp{t h_k(W(y)-mu_z)/tau_k^2-Lambda_{z,k}(t h_k/tau_k^2)}. This gives dU_k/dt at zero equal to h_k. State dot ell_k(O)=1{Z in S_k}(W(Z)-mu_Z)/tau_k^2, phi_k(O)=q_k^(-1)1{Z in S_k}(W(Z)-mu_Z), I_B=diag(q_k/tau_k^2:k in A), and Sigma_B=I_B^(-1)=diag(tau_k^2/q_k:k in A), with q replaced by alpha in the CR regime. For P_{C,h}=P_{C^(-1/2),h}, display the LAN likelihood ratio log(dP_{C,h}^C/dP_0^C)=h' Delta_C-(1/2)h'I_B h+o_{P_0}(1), Delta_C=C^(-1/2)sum_c dot ell_A(O_c) => N(0,I_B), and the induced limit X_k=h_k+sqrt(tau_k^2/q_k)Z_k. State the all-measurable-randomized-rule lower bound with its missing normalization and order of limits: for every rule sequence delta_C, lim_{M->infinity} liminf_{C->infinity} sup_{h in H_A: ||h||<=M} sqrt(C) E_{P_{C,h}}[max_{k in A}U_k(P_{C,h})-U_{delta_C}(P_{C,h})] >= G_A(tau_A^2,q_A), also for rules observing the full experiment by the nuisance-deletion theorem. Distinguish this general score construction from the special independent Bernoulli(1/2) target-bit witness, which only directly yields tau_k^2=1/4 and information 4q_k.

4. Define ranks at ties. With rank 1 best, set r_k^-(U)=1+sum_{j ne k}1{U_j>U_k}, r_k^+(U)=K-sum_{j ne k}1{U_j<U_k}, and Rank_k(U)={r_k^-(U),...,r_k^+(U)}. Define the inverted max-t set R_{C,k} accordingly and state the simultaneous target as Pr_P{Rank_k(U) subseteq R_{C,k}(gamma) for every k} >= 1-gamma asymptotically, uniformly over partial ties. Do not write the undefined scalar event rank(U_k) in R_{C,k}.

5. Correct arXiv:2506.24007 everywhere to Masahiro Kato as sole author, use a key such as Kato2026, and replace every “Kato and coauthors” or four-author attribution in the bibliography, related work, comparator table, literature map, seeds, and open question. Retain the exact version/date and characterize it only as the adaptive sequential best-arm comparator.

6. Add a feasible attained-risk strengthening for K>=3 rather than leaving the field claim as a homogeneity lower ratio. For fixed A, positive v and r, define a computable Gaussian selector (an epsilon-minimax finite-grid/least-favourable-prior selector is acceptable), provide certified bounds L_epsilon(v,r)<=G_A(v,r)<=U_epsilon(v,r) with U_epsilon-L_epsilon<=epsilon, and prove an oracle-to-data corollary showing that the same selector applied to the calibrated estimator, with consistent calibrated covariance and sample splitting if needed, attains the certified Gaussian upper risk under bounded local alternatives. Combine this with branch-and-bound over B Delta_K and Delta_A, using the positive active-coordinate domain above. Include at least one reproducible K=3 interior exact-count menu with rational B, certified Bernoulli and CR allocations, certified risk intervals, and a ratio interval. The universal full-contrast/covariance-boundary algorithm may remain open, but the paper must contain this finite general-menu achieved-risk certificate.

7. Position novelty conservatively: describe cross-label identification and the efficient-score result as a strict refinement of Han–Owusu–Shin, and the variance decomposition and rank inversion as supporting/incremental results. Center the field-level novelty claim on the all-rule nuisance-deletion theorem, the corrected face-specific optimized mechanism-deficiency/equality frontier, and the calibrated attainable general-menu design certificate.

Retain the revised kernel and make two explicit well-posedness repairs.

First, distinguish schedule laws from their induced observed-data laws. For regime B(p), let R_B,p be the known randomization/coarsening kernel from a schedule Y to O and define Q^B_{P,p}=P R_B,p. For CR with count vector C_C=(C_{C,k})_k, define the joint observed law Q^{CR}_{P,C_C}=P^{\otimes C}R^{CR}_{C_C}, equivalently condition on the randomized fixed-count label vector and use the product of its stratum-specific observed laws. State phi_k^B and dot ell_k^B in L^2_0(Q^B_{P_0,p}), and the CR influence/score coordinates in the corresponding stratum or triangular-array observed L^2 spaces, never in L^2(P_0). Let bar P_0=otimes_z P_{0,z} and bar P_{t,h}=otimes_z P_{t,h,z}. Since bar P_0 and P_0 induce the same observed law, write the LAN ratios as log[d(Q^B_{bar P_{C,h},p})^{\otimes C}/d(Q^B_{P_0,p})^{\otimes C}] and log[dQ^{CR}_{bar P_{C,h},C_C}/dQ^{CR}_{P_0,C_C}], the latter conditionally on L if convenient. This makes the displayed observed scores genuinely induced by legal schedule-law paths while preserving observational equivalence at t=0.

Second, use a coherent full-K/active-face two-layer notation. Define Sigma_B^(K)=diag(tau_k^2/q_k:k in K) and, only when alpha_k>0 for every k, Sigma_CR^(K)=diag(tau_k^2/alpha_k:k in K). The full estimator and covariance estimator are tilde U_C in R^K and hat Sigma_C^(K) in S_+^K. State the Bernoulli full-K CLT with Sigma_B^(K), and the CR full-K CLT only under the all-positive-share assumption. For mechanism, LAN, and oracle-transfer results requiring positivity only on A, use tilde U_{C,A}, hat Sigma_{C,A}, Sigma_{B,A}=(Sigma_B^(K))_{AA}, and Sigma_{CR,A}=diag(tau_k^2/alpha_k:k in A). The rank theorems remain full-K and must use hat Sigma_C^(K), Sigma_B^(K) or Sigma_CR^(K), nondegeneracy for every reported policy, and, under CR, alpha_k>0 for every k. Do not claim convergence of a K-by-K estimator to an A-by-A matrix or consistency for an unallocated inactive policy.

Make the Han comparison theorem-level, but derive rather than assume its variance. Transcribe Appendix-B Eq. (S1), including its exact HT/Hajek normalization, and derive its influence function under the present notation. Also define the best regular estimator in the nominal-label-k subexperiment, whose efficiency bound is tau_k^2/(p_k B_kk). Then, whenever q_k>p_kB_kk and tau_k^2>0, tau_k^2/q_k < tau_k^2/(p_kB_kk) <= AVAR(Han Eq. S1). If the exact Eq. (S1) influence uses W-U_k rather than assignment-cell residuals, display its additional b_k^2 term (and any HT participation term) explicitly; use b_k^2>0 as a heterogeneous-cell condition yielding an additional strict calibration gain. Do not attribute (tau_k^2+b_k^2)/(p_kB_kk) to Eq. (S1) unless its actual normalization gives that formula.

Promote thm:mechanism-loss as the sole headline; present efficiency/LAN as its primitive foundation and rank inference as supporting. Replace the symmetric n=6, m=(1,3,5), equal-v worked example by a genuinely non-symmetric K>=3 menu: the count set should not be invariant under m -> n-m, and preferably v should also be unequal. Recompute B, the certified Bernoulli and CR optimizers, risk intervals, ratio interval, and whether the s_{A,max}^{-1/2} equality condition holds; retain only machine- or interval-certified numbers. Use this example to demonstrate a non-symmetry-forced optimizer and substantive coupling through B Delta_K. Position the general-menu novelty as the coupling of a certified static Gaussian selector to the exact-hit polytope and calibrated cluster-data transfer, not as a new generic Gaussian minimax construction beyond Joo.
